name: ton-deploy
description: It is a compilation of Docker compose files for starting TON node, API, database, indexer and NGinx.

scripts.lint: echo 'Linting shell scripts...' && shellcheck scripts/*.sh start.sh stop.sh 2>/dev/null || echo 'shellcheck not installed, skipping'
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.docker:build: docker-compose -f ton-compose.yaml build && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yaml build
scripts.docker:up: docker-compose -f ton-compose.yaml up -d && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yaml up -d
scripts.docker:down: docker-compose -f ton-compose.yaml down && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yaml down
